subject: Renewal: Brightlane SLA uplift & capacity expansion
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@brightlane.com>
To: michael_grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: SLA needs and headroom for Q4

Hi Michael,

Quick note as we're starting renewal planning for Brightlane. Our usage has been steadily increasing (peak tokens up ~3x since Jan) and the product team is pushing us to guarantee lower tail latency for inferencing in production. We're evaluating a stronger commitment at renewal: a Premium SLA with 99.95% p99 latency target, and a 1.5x reserved capacity bump for steady-state to avoid throttling during batch peaks.

Two key asks from our side:
- Pricing cadence: we need a fixed unit price for the reserved capacity year to justify the budget (ideally flat vs current).
- Evidence: SOC2 and a short architecture note on how you handle auto-fallbacks and capacity isolation.

Can we get a proposal by next week? Tom (cc'd) will own procurement questions.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of AI Platforms
Brightlane Analytics
From: michael_grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightlane.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: SLA needs and headroom for Q4

Elena —

Appreciate the heads-up. We can definitely bake a Premium SLA and the requested capacity into next year's contract. High-level proposal:
- Premium SLA: 99.95% p99 for text generation endpoints (measured across production tokens). This includes up to 2 automatic failovers per quarter with reduced latency impact.
- Reserved Capacity: add 1.5x of current committed vGPU-hours; configurable burst pool for short spikes.
- Pricing: hold unit price flat for the first 12 months with a 3% annual CPI floor thereafter; we can commit to the flat price if you take a 12-month reserved capacity commitment.

I'll pull together an SLA addendum and a short architecture note for SOC2 evidence. Monica will lead the pricing/contract doc and run the amendment through legal.

Does that align with Brightlane's expectations? If yes, I'll start a draft amendment and include a DocuSign link for signatures.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Brightlane_current_usage.csv (csv)]
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700

Looping you both in — this looks like a good upsell motion and qualifies for a standard Enterprise addendum. Quick operational notes for the SLA doc:
- We need to define measurement windows (30-day rolling for p99), incident credits (pro-rata token-based credits), and support response times for P1/P2 incidents.
- For the reserved capacity, specify baseline vGPU hours + burst pool sizing and preemption policy.

Vivek, can you prepare a one-page architecture summary on auto-fallback and cache isolation for Elena's SOC2 ask? I can draft the addendum and update the quote.

Monica
Director, Customer Success Operations

Drafted the one-pager and the SOC2 pointer list. Key bullets included:
- Auto-fallback: multi-variant routing with warm-standby model variants (failover < 2s for control plane, gradual traffic ramp).
- Cache isolation: per-tenant KV caching + prefix-based TTLs; no cross-tenant leakage; snapshots audited per deploy.
- Audit artifacts: link to SOC2 Type II report, recent penetration test summary, and flow diagrams.

Uploading docs to the secure drive and attaching the short architecture note here. I'm also proposing a 5% list-price discount for a 24-month commitment (to be reflected in the amendment).

Vivek
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the amendment draft (Brightlane_Renewal_MA_v2.pdf) plus the SLA addendum and the one-pager Vivek prepared. Highlights:
- Premium SLA: 99.95% p99 (30-day rolling window), incident credits outlined, P1 response < 1 hour.
- Reserved Capacity: +1.5x baseline vGPU-hours with a 10% burst pool for short windows; pre-negotiated burst pricing included.
- Pricing: flat unit price for 12 months with option for 5% discount on a 24-month term; exact line items in the PDF.

DocuSign link: https://na1-docsign.com/link/abc123

If the pricing and SLOs look good, sign the amendment and we'll schedule a migration window to reserve capacity for Q4. Happy to hop on a call if you want to walk through any of the nitty-gritty.

Best,
